grade_reason: Seven web searches and a check of her Assembly press releases and campaign site found no statement by Jacqui Irwin about AI since 1 January 2025, and none about catastrophic AI risk.
notes: All 7 searches ran; none was refused. Her best-known AI work is AB 2013 (2024, AI training data transparency, signed 28 September 2024), which is before the 1 January 2025 window. A search result showed AB 979 (2025-2026 session), an intent-only placeholder bill 'relating to artificial intelligence' authored by her; it has no substantive content in the text seen, its status was not checked, and it is not a statement, so it is not recorded. Her Assembly press releases (irwin.asmdc.org, first two listing pages, Sep 2025 to Oct 2026) contain nothing on AI; older listing pages were not checked. The 21 September 2026 release on Engaged California (AB 2103) was opened and does not mention AI. Her campaign site jacquiirwin.com has no AI or technology content and no issues page. She was not in the House, so she could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act. Not checked: local debates, candidate questionnaires, and Assembly floor or committee remarks on AI bills in 2025-2026 (for example votes or comments on state AI safety bills), which a reviewer may want to look at.
